text:
rachel_cs: Hey team — quick check-in for NovaHealth onboarding. They’ve hit a median p95 latency spike ~420ms over the last 48h and token cost per 1k is up 18% month-over-month. Renewal is coming up next quarter; I want to propose a proactive perf pilot to reduce unit cost and stabilize latency. My suggestion: 1) run an int8 quantized variant of their main model for non-critical user flows, 2) route latency-sensitive endpoints to their Dedicated pool with a model-fallback to hosted, 3) enable prefix KV caching for repeated prompts. Can we scope a canary and risk plan? @mike_se @priya_eng @tony_sre

mike_se: Quick yes on pursuing a quant pilot. Model architecture is compatible with int8 but we need accuracy delta on NovaHealth’s eval set (medical-safety prompts). I can run evals, but need their latest prompt set and a small labeled subset.

priya_eng: I can draft a canary config. Proposal: 5% traffic to quantized model, 15m ramp window, p95 SLO = 600ms, abort if accuracy drops >2% on their eval. Also will disable batching for those particular low-latency routes. Draft config:
```
route: /v1/summary
canary:
  variant: model-v3-int8
  traffic: 0.05
  metrics:
    - latency_p95: {threshold_ms:600}
    - accuracy_delta: {threshold_pct:2}
fallback: model-v3-ptq
cache:
  prefix_kv: true
  ttl_sec: 300
```

tonysre: Routing plan sounds good. We’ll pin route prefixes at the edge to Dedicated for production user-facing endpoints and have a fallback rule to hosted when Dedicated CPU/GPU usage >75% or error surge detected. Add circuit breaker: if error rate increases by 10pp or latency p95 >700ms for 5m, rollback. I’ll add alerts to the NovaHealth runbook.

elena_products: I’ll run an enablement call with the customer to align on expectations + collect their canonical prompt set for eval. Can we aim for Thurs 10am PT? Also capturing their qualitative feedback after one week of canary is critical for renewal messaging.

rachel_cs: Thanks — I’ll confirm Thurs with NovaHealth. @mike_se please run the eval and post scores in this thread. @priya_eng pls push the draft canary to staging and create the RFC doc with rollback steps. I’ll prep a customer note about what to expect and request permission to sample prompts for eval. :thumbsup:

opsbot: Canary job queued: deployment-id cny-2623, target 5% traffic -> scheduled in staging.

mike_se: Eval queued. Will post results by EOD and include per-prompt diff table. If accuracy drops on any safety-critical prompts I’ll flag immediately.

priya_eng: Pushed config to staging. Created RFC at /docs/rfc/novahealth-quant-canary.md — added notes on telemetry endpoints.

rachel_cs: Perfect. Follow-ups: 1) Slack thread to keep sync; 2) Post-mortem template ready if rollback happens; 3) Customer feedback form link to send after 7 days. I’ll own follow-ups with renewals team.

elena_products: +1 — I’ll own the feedback capture and summary for the CSM renewal pack.

rachel_cs: Closing loop — will update once NovaHealth confirms Thurs. Thanks all. :raised_hands:
